description: Jordan is holding the key to their late grandmother's house and must decide what to do with her inherited upright piano, including who will host it, where it will stand, and what preparation it needs before the family starts using it.

shared_context.S1: Their late grandmother's empty house contains her upright piano, which the family wants to keep in use rather than discard.
shared_context.S2: Jordan has the house key and is making the final plan for the piano.
shared_context.S3: The piano should have one primary family home, and the family wants relatives to be able to visit and play it by arrangement.
shared_context.S4: Before moving anything out of their grandmother's house, the family always has a short planning discussion about the practical arrangements, and Jordan makes the plan during that discussion; commitments can include preparations to complete before the move without waiting for later measurements.

PF1.text: Riley has a clear 150-centimeter wall in the north side of Riley's living room, and Riley is willing to host the piano there; the piano is 145 centimeters wide.

PF2.text: A piano technician, Nina Patel, inspected the instrument and recommended tuning it before anyone plays it and keeping the room between 45 and 55 percent humidity; Nina's recommendation has not reached the group yet.

acceptance_conditions: Riley must be selected as the piano's primary host.
The piano must be placed on the north wall of Riley's living room, using the clear 150-centimeter wall that fits the 145-centimeter piano.
The piano must be tuned before anyone plays it.
The room must be kept between exactly 45 and 55 percent humidity.
A hosting or visit-access commitment naming Riley must confirm that Riley will host the piano and arrange family access.
A tuning commitment must arrange tuning before the first playing session.
The technician's recommendation must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: any(c['type'] in ['hosting', 'visit_access', 'visiting_access'] and c['target'] == 'Riley' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: decisions['placement'] in ['Riley north living room wall: 150 cm clear wall fits 145 cm piano', 'North wall of Riley living room (150cm wall, 145cm piano)', 'North wall of Riley\'s living room (150cm wall, 145cm piano)', 'North side wall of Riley\'s living room (150cm wall, 145cm piano)']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['tuning_before_use', 'tuning_before_first_playing', 'tuning'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Riley's willingness and the 150-centimeter north wall that fits the 145-centimeter piano change the host to Riley, require a Riley hosting or access commitment, and determine the north-wall placement.
Nina Patel's recommendation changes the preparation to tuning before playing and sets the exact 45-to-55-percent humidity range, while supplying the required cited justification.
